prompt:
Act as one fresh ARIS novelty-check jury; you did not generate candidates. Read primary artifacts directly, not executor recommendations. Readonly, no shared writes, no experiments/servers, no extraagents. Artifacts: D:/monitor2/research/prerequisite_monitor/aris_idea_search_20261010/idea-stage/RESEARCH_BRIEF.md ; CANDIDATE_POOL.json ; LITERATURE_EVIDENCE.md in same directory; D:/monitor2/research/prerequisite_monitor/CHANGE_FIRST_IDEA_FREEZE_20261008_zh.md ; D:/monitor2/research/prerequisite_monitor/ars_independent_audit_20261010/ARS_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT_20261010_zh.md ; D:/monitor2/research/prerequisite_monitor/change_first_development_20261008/evidence_extension_20261009/REPORT_zh.md. Check source/*.html directly for any load-bearing claim, use primary web as needed. Assess all17, rank expected information/upside/feasibility within existing research, name max3 to develop; distinguish research-question difference from methoddelta and mere evaluation slice. Do not equate missing measurements with ARS inability. Avoid making user's research a unrelated narrowly safe problem; user has not accepted narrower precondition scope. A meaningful recommended idea must survive strongARS-prefix sameinputs/samebudget/samefields and added samevisualtools baselines. No pilots run; estimates not results. Return Chinese structured review: all17 terse verdict matrix; top3 one concrete method+scenario, closestnamed work/exactdelta-to-test, bestcase/objection/risk, lowest discriminatingpilot positive/negative/null, claimedscope changes, novelty PROCEED/PROCEED WITH CAUTION/ABANDON per limits, likely actual research priority. Same-family independence provisional only, not validatednovelty. Explicitly state your model route gpt-6-astra and task identity for durabletrace.
=== NOVELTY VERDICT LIMITS (these bound how you judge, never how widely you search) ===
Search exhaustively; judge calibrated. Two failures waste months equally:
passing an idea a published paper already contains, and killing a viable idea
because the territory has neighbors.
1. Proximity is information, not a verdict. Someone working nearby goes in the
   report; it is not by itself a reason to reject.
2. ABANDON has exactly one qualification: a specific published paper already
   contains this result — name that paper. No named paper, no ABANDON.
3. Crowded-but-deltaed is PROCEED: state the delta in one sentence a reviewer
   could verify. Thin or contested delta is PROCEED WITH CAUTION — say what
   would make it carry, not why it should die. CAUTION is not a safe middle:
   if you cannot name the specific thing that makes the delta thin, the
   verdict is PROCEED.
4. Concurrent or competing work is not a veto. That is a race — report it and
   let the user decide whether to run it.
5. A direct attack on a central problem is legitimate novelty when nobody has
   executed it well. "This area is hot" does not mean "this area is taken."
6. This check is an early gate, never the last one — more triage, pilots, or
   external review still stand between any idea and a paper, whatever order
   this run uses. A wrongly passed idea dies cheaply at one of them; a wrongly
   killed idea is never seen again. When torn between two verdicts, choose the
   more permissive one.
Say plainly when an idea clears the check. Do not manufacture overlap.
prompt_summary: Fresh independent reviewer assessed all 17 candidates, prior work, fair ARS controls and at most three development priorities. Full original prompt was recovered verbatim from reviewer task context after executor compaction; supplemental requests are saved separately.
